newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices firmed on Monday on strengthening differentials and an afternoon rebound in futures prices, traders said.

Distillate prices also rose, with jet/kero holding onto gains from earlier in the day fueled by reports of refiner buying in the Chicago market and continued strong demand in the region, traders said.
"There's been some non-Chicago area refiner buying in the Chicago market," one trader said earlier in the day. Strong demand has propelled jet/kero basis higher over the past two weeks.
Group Three prompt low sulphur diesel was bid 3.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil, with high sulphur talked 0.75 cent a gallon over the print.
Chicago prompt low sulphur was bid 3.50 cents over the print, with high sulphur 1.50 cent over, traders said.
Group Three unleaded gasoline was bid 2.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX March unleaded and heard done 2.60 cents over the print in early discussion, with premium 3.25 cents higher.
Chicago unleaded was talked 0.25 cent under to even with the print for prompt barrels, with premium 3.0 cents higher.
Jet/kero rose to bids 7.25 cents over the print in Group Three and 4.75 cents over in Chicago, traders said.
